title: BlobWorld
altText: Biomorphic sci-fi graffiti mural by Italian artist Mr Blob at The Bushwick Collective in Brooklyn, New York, featuring a surreal giant eye mechanical character merging into green leaves and roots.
description: Painted at The Bushwick Collective in Brooklyn, BlobWorld assembles a surreal sci-fi organism across a blue-toned wall: a biomechanical creature built around a giant eye dissolves into leaves, roots and a strikingly realistic human hand. At the top, a tiny mouse presses a spray-can valve and releases the vertical beam of neon green energy that splits the composition — a playful nod to the aerosol medium itself.
